signal: Maven AGI raised a $50M Series B (led by Dell Technologies Capital, total $78M) in mid-2025 and launched Maven Voice for live customer calls.

email.subject1: a signal play for Maven AGI
email.body1:
Mike, saw Maven AGI close its $50M Series B and ship Maven Voice for live calls.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Maven off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Maven AGI.

Post-Series B, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Maven needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Maven AGI.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Maven's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise, and the post-Series B stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Maven either way.
